title: Si vous n'avez (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Si vous n'avez. 6 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Sextus, Quintus, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos3011); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
